page.overview:
Who is Angelique Bouvier?

Angelique Bouvier (nee Marceau) is Marge's great-great-grandmother. She had 9 children with Marcel Bouvier.

Her maiden name and her husband's first name (and his mime-like appearance) are based off the famous late French mime Marcel Marceau.
